title: incident-bot: oncall runbook autodiagnostics helpers and slo-toolkit hints integration
author: Priya Mehta
release_notes: Adds helper utilities for oncall runbook autodiagnostics; integrates SLO hinting into incident summaries; no breaking API changes.
description:
Motivation: improve oncall effectiveness by surfacing runbook autodiagnostics and SLO hints directly in incident-bot summaries. This PR adds a lightweight helper layer used by incident-bot to generate compact runbook suggestions and integrates SLO-toolkit hinting so runbook suggestions include likely root causes and SLO-relevant indicators.

Summary of changes: - new incident-bot helpers: runbook_autodiag.py, runbook_ranker.py - slo-toolkit: added hints module and hint scoring util - incident-bot integration: wire up autodiagnostics into oncall summary pipeline and add telemetry tags for sampling - tests: unit tests for ranking heuristics and end-to-end fixture for summary generation - docs: small README and runbook authoring notes

Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-4321) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests (fixture) - [x] Telemetry events instrumented - [x] Feature flags added for gradual rollout - [x] Docs updated

How it works: runbook_autodiag extracts structured signals (error fingerprints, latency buckets, failing endpoints) from the incident context. runbook_ranker scores candidate runbooks by combining matching signals, historical success rates, and SLO-toolkit hint scores. The SLO hinter computes a short list of SLO-relevant hints (e.g. backlog spike, deployment change, infra throttle) using existing SLO-toolkit heuristics and returns confidence scores which are folded into the ranker. Helpers are intentionally small and synchronous to keep latency under 50ms in the summary pipeline; heavy diagnostics remain asynchronous.

Rollout plan: behind feature flag incident.autodiag.runbook_v1.1. Default off for production customers; enable in staging and a 10% oncall sample for one week, monitor: autodiag.success_rate, runbook.click_through, oncall_summary_latency, false_positive_rate. Gradual ramp if metrics stable.

Testing notes: run `pytest incident-bot/tests/test_autodiag.py` for unit coverage. The e2e fixture `tests/fixtures/summary_e2e.yaml` exercises a synthetic incident with SLO regressions and verifies runbook suggestions and hint annotations.

Related: ENG-4321, ENG-4437, SUP-1123. See docs/runbooks/README.md for runbook authoring guidelines.
